You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Kate Santos. Chimney sweep. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Search locket, Contract Quill, Trail compass, Dispatcher's headset, Energy Bar Wrapper. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Yo
